webpx — Darnelix.Webp command-line tool

Usage: webpx [global-options] <command> [arguments]

Commands:
  encode     Encode a PAM/PPM/PGM, BMP, or raw raster to a WebP file.
  decode     Decode a WebP file to a PAM/PPM/PGM, BMP, or raw raster.
  mux        Set/strip ICC/EXIF/XMP metadata or set animation loop/background color.
  demux      List a WebP container's chunks/frames, or extract a metadata payload.
  anim       Build an animated WebP from frames, or extract its frames.
  info       Print a WebP file's features (size, format, alpha, animation).
  version    Print the Darnelix.Webp implementation version.

Global options:
  --log-level <off|error|warn|info|debug|trace>  Set the library log level.
  --quiet                                        Errors only (log level error).
  --verbose                                      Verbose logging (log level debug).
  -h, --help                                     Show this help, or a command's help.

Run 'webpx <command> --help' for command-specific usage.

result.stdout:
Usage: webpx encode <input> <output.webp> [options]
       webpx encode <input> -o <output.webp> [options]

Encode a PAM/PPM/PGM, BMP, or headerless-raw raster to a WebP file.
The input container is taken from --in-format, else the input extension.

Input options:
  -o, --output <path>        Output path (alternative to the second argument).
  --in-format <fmt>          pam | ppm | pgm | pnm | bmp | raw (else inferred from the extension).
  --width <px>               Raw input width  (required for raw input).
  --height <px>              Raw input height (required for raw input).
  --format <layout>          Raw input layout: gray | rgb | rgba | bgr | bgra (required for raw).

Encode options:
  --lossless                 Encode losslessly (VP8L) instead of lossy (VP8).
  -q, --quality <0..100>     Quality (higher is better/larger). Default 75.
  -m, --method <0..6>        Effort (higher is slower/smaller). Default 4.
  --near-lossless <0..100>   Near-lossless preprocessing level (0 = off). Lossless only.
  --alpha-quality <0..100>   Alpha-plane compression effort. Default 100.
  --alpha-method <0|1>       Alpha compression: 0 = uncompressed, 1 = lossless. Default 1.
  --sharp-yuv                Use the higher-quality 'sharp' RGB->YUV path. Lossy only.
  --exact                    Preserve RGB under fully-transparent pixels.
  --target-size <bytes>      Target output size (two-pass). Lossy only; excludes --target-psnr.
  --target-psnr <db>         Target reconstruction PSNR (two-pass). Lossy only; excludes --target-size.
  --segments <1..4>          Number of VP8 segments (0 = automatic). Lossy only.
  -f, --filter-strength <0..100>  Loop-filter strength (0 = off). Lossy only. Default 60.
  --filter-sharpness <0..7>  Loop-filter sharpness. Lossy only.
  --passes <1..10>           Entropy-analysis passes for token-probability optimization.
  --threads                  Hint that worker threads may be used (output is identical).

Metadata (ICC/EXIF/XMP) is set with 'webpx mux', not here.

result.stdout:
Usage: webpx decode <input.webp> <output> [options]
       webpx decode <input.webp> -o <output> [options]

Decode a WebP file to a PAM/PPM/PGM, BMP, or headerless-raw raster.
The output container is taken from --out-format, else the output extension.

Options:
  -o, --output <path>        Output path (alternative to the second argument).
  --out-format <fmt>         pam | ppm | pgm | pnm | bmp | raw (else inferred from the extension).
  --format <layout>          rgba | bgra | argb | rgb | bgr. The decoded pixel layout.
                             Written verbatim for raw; for BMP/.pnm only its alpha
                             presence is used; PAM/PPM/PGM have a fixed layout.
  --crop <x,y,w,h>           Decode only this source sub-region.
  --scale <WxH>              Resize the (cropped) image to W x H.
  --flip                     Write the image bottom-up (vertical flip).
  --first-frame              For an animated input, decode its first frame as a still
                             (otherwise animated input is rejected).

result.stdout:
Usage: webpx mux <input.webp> -o <output.webp> [operations]

Edit a WebP container's chunks: set or strip the ICC/EXIF/XMP metadata, or set an
animation's loop count and background color. The image bitstream and frames are
preserved byte-exact; the VP8X flags are updated to match.

Operations (at least one required):
  --set-icc <file>           Set/replace the ICC color profile from <file>.
  --set-exif <file>          Set/replace the EXIF metadata from <file>.
  --set-xmp <file>           Set/replace the XMP metadata from <file>.
  --strip-icc                Remove the ICC color profile.
  --strip-exif               Remove the EXIF metadata.
  --strip-xmp                Remove the XMP metadata.
  --loop <n>                 Set the animation loop count (0 = forever). Animation only.
  --bgcolor <r,g,b,a>        Set the animation background color. Animation only.

Options:
  -o, --output <path>        Output path (required).

result.stdout:
Usage: webpx demux <input.webp> [options]

Inspect a WebP container without decoding pixels: list the top-level chunks and, for
an animation, its frames; or extract a metadata payload byte-exact.

Options:
  --get <icc|exif|xmp>       Extract that metadata chunk's payload (requires -o).
  -o, --output <path>        Output path for --get.

With no --get, prints a chunk/frame listing to stdout.

result.stdout:
Usage: webpx anim build   -o <output.webp> [options] <frame...>
       webpx anim extract <input.webp> -o <frame_%03d.pam> [options]

Build an animated WebP from frame images, or extract its composited frames.

anim build — assemble frames into an animation:
  -o, --output <path>        Output animated .webp (required).
  --loop <n>                 Loop count 0..65535 (0 = forever). Default 0.
  --bgcolor <r,g,b,a>        ANIM background-color hint. Default 255,255,255,255.
  --in-format <fmt>          pam|ppm|pgm|pnm|bmp|raw for every frame (else per-file extension).
  --width <px> --height <px> --format <layout>
                             Raw input geometry (raw frames only): gray|rgb|rgba|bgr|bgra.
  Per-frame options (sticky — apply to all following frames until changed):
  -d, --duration <ms>        Frame display duration. Default 100.
  --lossless                 Encode following frames losslessly (VP8L).
  -q, --quality <0..100>     Per-frame quality. Default 75.
  -m, --method <0..6>        Per-frame effort. Default 4.
  The first frame fixes the canvas size; every frame must be that size.

anim extract — write each frame to a numbered file:
  -o, --output <pattern>     Output pattern with one %d placeholder, e.g. frame_%03d.pam (required).
  --out-format <fmt>         pam|ppm|pgm|pnm|bmp|raw (else inferred from the pattern's extension).
  --format <layout>          rgba|bgra|argb|rgb|bgr. Written verbatim for raw; for
                             bmp/.pnm only its alpha presence is used; pam/ppm/pgm are fixed.
  --manifest <path>          Also write a per-frame durations manifest.

result.stdout:
Usage: webpx info <file>

Print a WebP file's header features without decoding pixels:
  dimensions, still-image format (Lossy/Lossless), and the alpha
  and animation flags. Mirrors the library's Webp.GetFeatures.
